Each band in the gel signifies a DNA fragment. It is often used in forensic investigations.</p> <h6>Disclaimer</h6><p>In adherence to the principles of due process, all individuals in this exercise shall be presumed innocent until proven guilty beyond a reasonable doubt in a court of law.</p> <h6>Instructions</h6><p>Examine the provided DNA gel profile to identify which suspect is responsible for leaving the blood sample.
